answers.core: This feature should be core because the default `TileSet` collision editor is very inefficient at quickly creating collisions. Implementing this saves time a lot and prevents lots of errors regarding making sure that the collisions are aligned correctly, especially with larger tilesets where we cannot easily see how two distinct tiles connect.
answers.workaround: This can be worked around with an editor plugin, but it's not very convenient.

title: Automatic TileSet collisions based on Terrain bitmask
